title: Exclusion of turnover from the turnover of the subsidiary
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Exclusion of turnover from the turnover of the subsidiary Mar 22, 2001| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, B Wing, First Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021. SMD/Policy/Cir.No.24/25374/2001 March 22, 2001 The President/Executive Director/Managing Director All Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Sub : Exclusion of turnover from the turnover of the subsidiary Please find enclosed a copy of the SEBI (Stock Brokers and Sub-Brokers) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2000 dated 30th August, 2000. You may advise your members suitably. Yours faithfully, D. RAVIKUMAR DEPUTY GENERAL MANAGER SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Encl:a.a.
